alerts.headline: Lake Wind Advisory issued October 26 at 1:23AM PDT until October 26 at 6:00PM PDT by NWS Reno NV
alerts.description:
* CHANGES...None.

* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph for
Washoe Lake.

* WHERE...Greater Reno-Carson City-Minden Area.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 6 PM PDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds and rough waves on area lakes will create
hazardous conditions for small craft.
alerts.instruction:
Check lake conditions before heading out and be prepared for a sudden
increase in winds and wave heights. Consider postponing boating
activities on the lake until a day with less wind.
